chose: DELETE /auth/phones/:id signs one paired phone out, from a browser's passkey session only, scoped to the account that asks; 404 for an id that is none of its phones. With GET and PATCH /auth/phones it raises the contract epoch to 12.
options: a route to sign one phone out
only sign out everywhere, or the phone's own sign-out
gray: The owner asked to list phones; signing out a lost one otherwise means signing out everywhere. It is the optional route the story allowed.
undo: Remove the route from routes/auth.rs and raise CONTRACT_EPOCH again.
